## About
Cologne Auto Body is a collision repair shop on Old County Road in Belmont, serving Belmont, San Mateo, San Carlos and the surrounding cities from a convenient Central Peninsula location.
We specialize in unibody collision repair and frame straightening, painting and color matching. We use computerized digital imaging and graphic printouts so your car goes back together to factory specs, and we work on all makes and models with genuine factory parts.
We're rated 4.8 on Google from 65 reviews. A driver whose car was hit by a deer wrote that Samantha and her team were honest, professional and straightforward about the estimate, cost and timeline.

## Services
- Unibody collision repair and frame straightening: Structural repair after an accident, from fender benders to bigger hits, on all makes and models.
- Painting and color matching: Panel repainting with careful color matching so the repair blends with the rest of your car.
- Free local towing: Local towing at no charge, and we can tow your car from anywhere in the Bay Area.
- Rental car on arrival: Your rental car can be waiting to meet you when you arrive.
- Insurance negotiation and settlement: We work with your insurance company on negotiation and settlement of your claim.

## FAQ
Q: Do you accept insurance?
A: Yes. We accept insurance and can handle negotiation and settlement with your insurance company.

Q: What if my car was dropped off by emergency tow?
A: Local emergency towing drop-offs are credited towards your repair costs.

Q: Can you do factory warranty work?
A: Yes. Cologne is certified and authorized to do factory warranty work.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're open Monday through Friday and closed on Saturday and Sunday.
